# Skills index
<!-- Generated by system/kit/adapter_indexes.py at build time from the SKILL.md frontmatter of every skill that ships. Do not edit. -->

Amp, Claude Code and Codex load these skills from disk (`.agents/skills/`, `~/.agents/skills/`, or
`~/.claude/skills/`; see `adapters/README.md`). Chat tools such as ChatGPT have no skill loader: pick the
skill whose description matches the task and paste the body of its `SKILL.md` (and any file it
references) into the conversation after `adapters/SYSTEM.md`. The third-party skills under
`system/vendor/skills/` are listed in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.

23 skills.

| Skill | Use when | File |
|---|---|---|
| `asd-ste100` | Rewrites ambiguous English into ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English — one meaning per word, active voice, simple tense, short sentences. Use when simplifying, clarifying, or de-ambiguating tool descriptions, error messages, prompts, agent instructions, or any English an agent must parse. Triggers: simplify this, STE100 rewrite, reduce ambiguity, apply ASD-STE100. | `.agents/skills/asd-ste100/SKILL.md` |
